newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX retreats from yr-high as blue chips dip.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX retreats from yr-high as blue chips dip.

text.p: Leading Slovak shares were little changed in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Wednesday, but losses to some blue chips pulled the SAX index down from Tuesday's year high.
The SAX dropped 1.80 points to 205.95 from its year-high of 207.75 in the previous session.
"The SAX's fluctuation appears to be cyclical and may be dependent on forthcoming general shareholders' meetings," said Bohus Betko of ING Barings.
Investment fund VUB Kupon, which traded in blocks at 685 crowns at mid-session -- though it closed up only seven crowns higher at 635.
But losses to steelmaker VSZ, down 20 to 700, VUB, down 20 to 1,700 and Slovakofarma, which shed 113 crowns to close at 4,883 contributed to the lower SAX.
"Demand for this issue (VUB Kupon) is growing because the forthcoming sherholders' meeting is expected to approve a decent dividend," Betko said.
Overall volume fell to 218,240 shares traded from 395,704 traded on Tuesday, while turnover eased to 178.6 million crowns from338.9 million.
